scope: Every identified EMC condition in eligible retained expression sources; bounded primary literature gate. No assertion all public EMC evidence has been evaluated.

expression_sources.primary_subset: Nine primary observations after three known cross-study exclusions and one recurrence; independence and each fusion partner not established.
expression_sources.overlap: Three known array overlaps retained as context, not counted as replication; other donor overlap unresolved.

expression_sources.annotation: Six targets mapped by source GeneIDs/unambiguous assignment; NECTIN4 historical PVRL4 successfully resolved. F3 alias TF never substituted for transferrin.
expression_sources.overlap: Known historical Hofvander exclusions not a complete donor crosswalk or proven independent replication.

expression_sources.units: Tumor/reference log2 ratios, not absolute abundance
expression_sources.missing: Per-target/per-spot missing rows explicit in RESULTS; no missing-to-zero substitution.
expression_sources.overlap: Possible within/other historical cohort overlap unresolved; not independent validation.

primary_sources.conditions: All six male metastatic EMC patients; five RNA-QC passing observations, one inadequate RNA with prior archival EWSR1-NR4A3 FISH. Fresh metastatic biopsy5, archived metastatic sample1.
primary_sources.interpretation: Published RNA heterogeneity/outlier hypothesis and folate-targeting suggestion are prior art. No protein, accessible surface epitope, ADC efficacy or poor-RNA absence inference.
primary_sources.overlap: Donor overlap with other expression cohorts unresolved.

primary_sources.conditions: One author-labelled extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma among22 other-cancer enrollment observations;60 enrolled59 treated overall. Main text does not link the pre-dose dropout to histology.
primary_sources.interpretation: Existing EMC trial enrollment must not be omitted. No EMC benefit/failure estimate or molecular authentication inferred from aggregate response counts.
primary_sources.overlap: Unknown donor overlap with all other cohorts; main text supplies no NR4A3 confirmation.

primary_sources.conditions: One45-year-old woman, index breast tumor; review TableIa includes21 author-labelled cases, six rows explicitly HER2-negative.
primary_sources.interpretation: A measured negative index case with incomplete canonical authentication; do not assign21 negative measurements or calculate authenticated EMC sensitivity.
primary_sources.overlap: Review references are not separate molecular validations; duplicate reporting and identity unresolved.

primary_sources.conditions: One41-year-old woman, vacuum-assisted breast core biopsy; included as review row3.
primary_sources.interpretation: Preserve reported negative measurement as identity-unresolved; no molecularly authenticated EMC denominator.
primary_sources.overlap: Same case as breast review row3, not independent validation.

primary_sources.conditions: One45-year-old woman, metaplastic breast carcinoma with predominant chondrosarcoma; misincluded as breast review row13.
primary_sources.interpretation: Useful mimic control; unsuitable as authenticated EMC HER2-negative measurement. Preserve the review discrepancy without external correction.
primary_sources.overlap: Same case as breast review row13.

primary_sources.conditions: 20 localized soft-tissue sarcoma participants, including one grade2 EMC in eight grade2 tumors; blood microvesicles pre/post surgery,18 pooled post-R0 participants.
primary_sources.interpretation: Measured F3-related circulating compartment, not EMC tumor-cell accessible tissue factor protein. No tumor-localization inference or individual EMC effect estimate.
primary_sources.overlap: Single EMC clinical donor; all linked numerical conditions remain unavailable in main text.

primary_sources.conditions: Table2 lists three extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma patients in the phase-I ultrarare sarcoma population.
primary_sources.interpretation: Broader clinical source containing EMC; not proof of ADC treatment or absence.
primary_sources.overlap: Possible overlap with SAMBA101 at same center; do not sum as independent cases.

primary_sources.conditions: 75 first-line experimental patients explicitly include one EMC. Full587 cohort Table1 reports four extraskeletal chondrosarcomas, lacking a myxoid-specific individual crosswalk.
primary_sources.interpretation: First-line EMC is identifiable, broader generic four-case label must not silently be called authenticated EMC. Individual antigen/clinical endpoints remain unresolved.
primary_sources.overlap: Possible overlap with SAMBA102; repeated trial enrollments also reported.

primary_sources.conditions: 115 soft-tissue sarcomas in primary abstract; candidate returned by EMC fulltext-index query, but EMC membership/individual count unresolved.
primary_sources.interpretation: Do not transfer87%aggregate sarcoma positivity to EMC. Primary EMC eligibility and localized antigen staining pending source access.

primary_sources.conditions: 102 benign/malignant musculoskeletal tumors in primary abstract; EMC eligibility unresolved.
primary_sources.interpretation: Full-length surface and intracellular truncated fragments cannot be conflated. No EMC inference from musculoskeletal aggregate.

primary_sources.source: Other breast review measured HER2 rows2/8/15: Cong2018,Errahay2013,Gurleyik2009
primary_sources.conditions: Three source-reported HER2-negative rows; original molecular identity and assay details unresolved.
primary_sources.interpretation: No authenticated EMC negative denominator; original reports remain review candidates.
primary_sources.overlap: Already included in21-row review, not new donors.

unassessed_primary_catalogue: Primary-search metadata catalogue contains128 unique rows across seven target/ADC queries (NECTIN4 query zero indexed hits). Discovery/title inspection is not full-source evaluation. Relevant unresolved sources retain pending/unavailable status; missing EMC-linked values are never zeros.
coverage_decision: No positive claim. Pending clinical IHC/response, full source c-Met panels, original breast identities and complete protein compartment evidence block promotion. Failed prospective rule permits shelving without treating these as excluded negatives.
